high_level_description: The image is a cover of Elle Singapore magazine. The background is a solid light gray color, providing a neutral backdrop that highlights the subject. The word "ELLE" is prominently displayed in large, white, uppercase letters at the top of the cover, with "SINGAPORE" written below it in smaller, uppercase letters. In the center of the image, there is a person wearing a black sleeveless dress adorned with small, sparkling embellishments near the waistline. The individual has shoulder-length dark hair and is holding the hem of their dress with both hands, slightly pulling it up.
